{{Quote|In all of my travels, I've never seen an animal stranger than the Endorian chicken, but it's not without its uses.|[[Dexter Jettster/Legends|Dexter Jettster]]|<ref name="DAD">{{Hyperspace|url=fans/hyperspace/source/dexdiner/index.html|text=Dining at Dex's|int=Dining at Dex's}}</ref>}}
'''Endorian chickens''', also known as '''tip-yip''' in [[Ewokese/Legends|Ewokese]], were a [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Bird/Legends|birds]] that lived in the [[Tree/Legends|forests]] of [[Endor/Legends|Endor]]. These domesticated animals were kept by the [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]] primarily as a source of [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]], and their meat was considered delicious.

==Anatomy==
Chickens were a [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Sentience/Legends|non-sentient]] [[Bird/Legends|fowl]] hailing from [[Endor/Legends|Endor]],<ref name="CCEA" /> a lush [[Moon/Legends|moon]] orbiting [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Endor (planet)/Legends|Tana]].<ref name="GORW">''[[Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds]]''</ref> They had two thin legs with three clawed toes and an additional spur-like growth on the back of the foot. They also had puff crests of feathers, short wings and a feathered tail.<ref name="CCEA" />

==The chickens in culture==
The sentient [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]], a race of diminutive [[Alien/Legends|aliens]] from Endor, kept these chickens for their meat,<ref name="CCEA" /><ref name="ROJ">{{Film|VI}}</ref> which was known offworld to be succulent&mdash;according to the [[Besalisk/Legends|Besalisk]] [[Chef/Legends|chef]] [[Dexter Jettster/Legends|Dexter Jettster]]. During the final decade of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], Jettster served the [[Endorian chicken pot pie]] and [[fried Endorian chicken]] at [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]], his restaurant located in [[CoCo Town/Legends|CoCo Town]], [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="DAD" />

The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[All Terrain Scout Transport/Legends|All Terrain Scout Transport]] [[Walker/Legends|walker]] was nicknamed "chicken walker" after the creature.<ref name="AGTSWU2">''[[A Guide to the Star Wars Universe, Second Edition, Revised and Expanded]]''</ref> The [[Ewokese/Legends|Ewokese]] name for the species was "tip-yip."<ref name="GPBTG">[[Galactic Phrase Book & Travel Guide (real-life book)|''Galactic Phrase Book & Travel Guide'']]</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The real life fowls that appeared in the [[1984]] made-for-TV film ''[[Caravan of Courage: An Ewok Adventure]]''<ref name="CCEA" /> resembled the breeds of Silkies and Polish [[Wikipedia:Polish (chicken)|chickens]], which have either the characteristics of bouffant crest of feathers or feathers that resemble fur.<ref name="MPC">{{WebCite|url=https://www.mypetchicken.com/chicken-breeds/Polish-B91.aspx|text=Chicken breeds&mdash;Polish|work=[http://www.mypetchicken.com myPetChicken.com]|archivedate=20190618133252}}</ref> The Endorian chicken was also mentioned in the [[Galactic Phrase Book & Travel Guide (real-life book)|''Galactic Phrase Book & Travel Guide'']] as a word to say to the native Ewoks.<ref name="GPBTG" />
